units.source_text: 右近不能作答诗，只是在想：“此时若得小姐随伴公子身旁……”

en.t: Ukon could not compose a reply poem; she could only think, "If only my young lady were here beside the prince at this moment..."

units.source_text: 想到这里，哀思充塞胸中。

en.t: At that thought, sorrow filled her heart.

units.source_text: 源氏公子回想起五条地方刺耳的砧声，也觉得异常可爱，

en.t: Prince Genji recalled the harsh sound of the fulling blocks in the Gojo quarter, and even that seemed strangely dear to him,

units.source_text: 信口吟诵“八月九月正长夜，千声万声无了时”的诗句[\[37\]](#part1333.html#m37)，便就寝了。

en.t: then casually recited the lines, "In the long nights of August and September, a thousand voices, ten thousand voices, never cease"[\[37\]](#part1333.html#m37), and went to bed.
